input.summary: Replace the Servicer's blanket refusal to license servicing systems with an irrevocable, transferable licence to the Issuer, its Affiliates and its contractors (including any Successor Servicer), retaining the legal/regulatory and third-party restriction carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We need a licence of the servicing processes, models and software so that a Successor Servicer (or our Affiliates and contractors) can actually service the Receivables on a servicing transfer; as drafted the Servicer may simply refuse, which leaves us with no path to continuity. We have therefore added a non-exclusive, irrevocable, royalty-free licence extending to our Affiliates and contractors and transferable to successors, while preserving the carve-outs for genuine third-party transfer restrictions and legal, regulatory, privacy and data protection limits.

ops.oldText: The Servicer will not be obligated to provide, license or assign its processes, procedures, models, servicing software or other applications to any Successor Servicer or any third party, or provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment or a confidentiality agreement or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
ops.newText: The Servicer hereby grants to the Issuer, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on its behalf (including any Successor Servicer) a non-exclusive, irrevocable, royalty-free license, transferable to any successor to the Issuer and to any Successor Servicer, to use the Servicer's processes, procedures, models, servicing software and other applications solely to the extent necessary to service the Receivables, and the Servicer will provide, license or assign the same to any Successor Servicer on request; provided, that the Servicer will not be obligated to provide anything covered by a restriction on transfer or assignment in favor of an unaffiliated third party or a confidentiality agreement with an unaffiliated third party, or otherwise restricted by legal, regulatory, privacy or data protection policies.
